## Description

IMMUNIZATION: vaccine, dose, date given, batch, who gave it, or deferred with a reason. The country schedule (India IAP 2023, UAE national) is a country rule class; the chart lists each age band as given, due now, overdue or upcoming from the child's date of birth. DEVELOPMENTAL_MILESTONE: per age band, each milestone answered yes, no or unsure, with who answered (parent or clinician). Vaccines due feed the care gaps (MDV-P2-038).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The schedule is chosen by the facility's country through a country rule class, never an if on the country.
- [ ] **AC2.** Due and overdue are worked out from the date of birth in the facility time zone and tested at the band edges.
- [ ] **AC3.** Deferring a dose needs a reason; nothing is deleted.
- [ ] **AC4.** shortcut: the schedules are the design's reading of IAP 2023 and the UAE schedule and are marked unverified until clinical sign-off.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
